name: signet
description: Signet: AI agent governance, runtime enforcement and evidence platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n control,gw-a1,gw-a2,web -c blue,magenta,magenta,green "npm run start -w @signet/control" "npm run start -w @signet/gateway" "npm run start:a2 -w @signet/gateway" "npm run dev -w @signet/web"
scripts.dev:api: concurrently -k -n control,gw-a1,gw-a2 -c blue,magenta,magenta "npm run start -w @signet/control" "npm run start -w @signet/gateway" "npm run start:a2 -w @signet/gateway"
scripts.test:sdk: cd sdk/python && uv run --with httpx --with pytest --with openai pytest -q tests
